'''Neskett''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] merchant living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], he owned a small shop where he bought, sold, and created artifacts and relics.
